subject: Operations
title: Technology Choices
description: A quick, practical guide to Technology Choices.

hook.text: A factory buys a $5M robot. It breaks down because the team wasn't trained. Technology without skill is waste.

buildup.text: Technology choices include automation level, information systems, and equipment sophistication.

discovery.text: The right technology depends on volume, variety, labor cost, and the skills available to operate and maintain it.

twist.text: High-tech isn't always the answer. Simple, reliable tools sometimes outperform expensive automation.

climax.text: Toyota uses simple automation where it helps and avoids it where human judgment adds more value.

punchline.text: Choose technology that fits, not technology that impresses.

quiz.question: What should technology choices depend on?
